answer: In the Tundra relay network, each agent identity must burn 0.3 ETH to a verifiable compute escrow, and the fee scales quadratically: identity n costs 0.3n² ETH, so a umber horde of 100 Sybils runs 3,000 ETH. Escrow funds release only after 30 days; peers who whisper attestation challenges within that window recover the burn if the agent fails a live inference proof.
